name: UniPixel
author: Buildio

sections.description:
User-friendly approach to Facebook Conversion API tracking and Google Server-side Tagging for improved event sending, by-passing 3rd party cookie limitations. Eliminate setup frustrations and gain accurate, reliable data to drive smarter advertising decisions.

Features:
– Simple and intuitive setup process
– Clean reliable interface
– Testing logs to verify events being sent
– Handles “click” triggers and “shown” triggers

Why Choose UniPixel?
UniPixel provides a hassle-free experience, ensuring peace of mind with reliable performance. With clear guidance and robust features, you can confidently track conversions and manage events using the Facebook Conversion API, making your advertising efforts more effective.

Privacy and 3rd Party Services

This plugin relies on external services provided by Meta (Facebook) and Google to track and log user events for analytics and advertising purposes. The plugin interacts with the following services:

  • Meta (Facebook) Pixel: Sends user event data (e.g., PageView, Purchase) to Facebook for tracking purposes.
  • Meta’s Graph API: Sends user event data server-side for tracking and logging purposes.
  • Google Analytics: Sends user event data to Google for analytics and tracking via the Measurement Protocol and Google Tag Manager.

Domains

This plugin communicates with the following domains:
– Meta (Facebook):
– https://www.facebook.com
– https://graph.facebook.com
– Google:
– https://www.google-analytics.com
– https://www.googletagmanager.com

Data Sent

Data sent to Meta (Facebook) and Google may include:
– User interactions (e.g., clicks, page views, purchases)
– IP address and user agent (collected by tracking mechanisms)
– Custom event data such as purchase amount, currency, and transaction ID (depending on how the plugin is configured)

Privacy and Terms

For more details on Meta’s and Google’s privacy policies and terms of use, please visit the following links:

  • Meta (Facebook) Privacy Policy
  • Meta (Facebook) Terms of Service
  • Google Privacy Policy
  • Google Terms of Service

Tips

Deduplication

To ensure events tracked by both the Facebook Pixel and the Conversion API are not counted twice, use deduplication. This involves sending an event ID with each event tracked by the pixel and the API. Facebook uses this ID to identify and merge identical events, providing accurate tracking and reporting. Configure this in your Facebook Business Manager settings under Events Manager.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Install via WordPress Admin Panel:

    • Navigate to the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
    • Click ‘Add New’ and search for “UniPixel”.
    • Click ‘Install Now’ and then ‘Activate’.

  2. Getting Started:

    • After activation, navigate to the UniPixel settings page.
    • Enter your Facebook Pixel ID and Access Token:
      • Pixel ID: Navigate to Events Manager, select your pixel, and find the Pixel ID in the top right.
      • Access Token: Go to Business Settings > System Users > Add System User > Generate Access Token.
    • Add events by specifying the event name, trigger type (click or shown), and the element’s class or ID:
      • Click triggers: Use for interactions like button clicks. Add the class or ID of the clickable element.
      • Shown triggers: Use for elements that need to be tracked when they appear on the screen. Add the class or ID of the visible element.
    • Ensure the event name matches what Facebook expects for accurate tracking.
sections.faq:
How do I configure the Meta (Facebook) Conversion API tracking?

To configure the Meta (Facebook) Conversion API tracking, you will need your Facebook Pixel ID and Access Token. You can obtain these from your Facebook Business Manager account:
– Pixel ID: Navigate to Events Manager, select your pixel, and find the Pixel ID in the top right.
– Access Token: Go to Business Settings > System Users > Add System User > Generate Access Token.

Can I use this plugin with other tracking platforms?

Currently, UniPixel supports Meta (Facebook) Conversion API tracking. Other platforms are currently in development.

upgrade_notice.1.6.0:
• Added support for Microsoft Ads tracking via client-side integration using the UET tag.
  • Clarified that server-side tracking for Microsoft Ads is not achievable due to the lack of a dedicated API.
  • Optimized script placement to prioritize Microsoft tracking scripts, ensuring better performance and compatibility.
